macros.name: abutcircleabove
macros.doc: For \abutcircleabove, the shadow is abutted against three tangents to the current circle, that touch at the top of the circle and at the two points 45 degrees to the left and right of the top, and is then given the lowest of the three positions obtained by these abutments.

macros.name: border
macros.doc: \border moves the left and right sides outwards by its first parameter, and raises the top and lowers the bottom by its second parameter.

macros.name: borderto
macros.doc: \borderto enlarges the current rectangle so that its width is at least the first parameter and its height (including depth) is at least the second parameter.

macros.name: circleheaddisp
macros.doc: The arrowhead will be advanced towards its tip by the distance \circleheaddisp.

macros.name: cten
macros.doc: \cten draws an edge from x-start to x-end, after shading the start and end points with any shadows associated with these points on the vertex list.

macros.name: ctinnermid
macros.doc: If \ctinnermid (described below) has been called most recently, then the midpoint will be computed after displacement and shading, so that it will be the midpoint of the actual line segment that is printed.

macros.name: ctnohead
macros.doc: \cthead (\ctnohead) causes subsequent executions of the edge-drawing macros described below to draw (not to draw) arrowheads.

macros.name: ctvertexborderlr
macros.doc: The control symbols \ctvertexborderlr and \ctvertexbordertb are defined to be 3pt and 4pt respectively, but may be redefined by the user.

macros.name: ctvertexbordertb
macros.doc: The control symbols \ctvertexborderlr and \ctvertexbordertb are defined to be 3pt and 4pt respectively, but may be redefined by the user.

macros.name: ctvertexstyle
macros.doc: The control symbol \ctvertexstyle is defined to be \displaystyle, but may be redefined by the user.

macros.name: diamond
macros.doc: \diamond defines the current shadow to be a square, just large enough to enclose the current rectangle, whose sides have slope (+ or - 1), (+ or - 1).

macros.name: drawcircle
macros.doc: \drawcircle draws the current circle.

macros.name: drawcirclehead
macros.doc: \drawcirclehead draws an arrowhead on the current circle, at the intersection with a directed line segment starting at the center with a slope determined by the first two parameters.

macros.name: drawdashedge
macros.doc: \drawdashedge draws the current edge as a dashed line.

macros.name: drawdotedge
macros.doc: \drawdotedge draws the current edge as a dotted line.

macros.name: drawedgehead
macros.doc: \drawedgehead draws an arrowhead on the current edge at a distance from the start point of p times the length of the edge, where p is the first parameter divided by 100.

macros.name: drawsolidedge
macros.doc: \drawsolidedge draws the current edge as a solid line.

macros.name: hexagon
macros.doc: \hexagon defines the current shadow to be a hexagon with two horizontal sides identical with the top and bottom of the current rectangle, and four sides of slope (+ or - 1), (+ or - 2).

macros.name: leftghost
macros.doc: \leftghost sets \xcenter to the left of the current rectangle plus half the width of the hbox.

macros.name: octagon
macros.doc: \octagon defines the current shadow to be an octagon inscribed in the current rectangle.

macros.name: outline
macros.doc: \outline draws the current shadow.

macros.name: place
macros.doc: \place behaves the same way as \vertex, except that nothing is placed on the vertex list.

macros.name: placed
macros.doc: \placed behaves the same way as \place, except that the coordinates at which the center point is placed are expressed by dimensions rather than numbers.

macros.name: rect
macros.doc: \rect defines the current shadow to be the current rectangle.

macros.name: rightghost
macros.doc: \rightghost sets \xcenter to the right of the current rectangle minus half the width of the hbox.

macros.name: rorect
macros.doc: \rorect defines the current shadow to be a rectangle with rounded (i.e. quarter-circle) corners.

macros.name: setcircle
macros.doc: \setcircle defines the current circle to have a diameter given by the first parameter and a center defined by the second and third parameter.

macros.name: setedge
macros.doc: \setedge makes the current edge a directed line segment from the point ``start'' given by its first two parameters to the point ``end'' given by its last two parameters.

macros.name: shadeedge
macros.doc: \shadeedge changes the extent of the current edge, without displacing or rotating it, to exclude the portions of the edge lying within shadows associated with its start and end points.

macros.name: shiftcircle
macros.doc: \shiftcircle displaces the current circle by the vector described by its parameters.

macros.name: shiftedge
macros.doc: \shiftedge displaces the current edge by a vector whose length is determined by the <dimen:length> parameter, and whose direction is obtained by rotating the current edge 90 degrees counterclockwise.

macros.name: symmetrize
macros.doc: \symmetrize raises the top or lowers the bottom so that they are equally distant from the center point.

macros.name: vertex
macros.doc: \vertex sets the <balanced mathematical text> in math mode, with text style, and creates an expression state containing the resulting expression, with the current rectangle just enclosing the expression.
